title: Appointment of an Acting Treasurer
subtitle: Council also discussed by-law posting practices and asked for by-laws to be attached to future special meeting agendas.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting to consider a single by-law appointing an Acting Treasurer. The by-law, numbered 26-046, also repeals By-Law Number 24-033. According to the minutes, Kedar Tupil was appointed as Acting Treasurer. The by-law was enacted through the general by-law motion, which carried {{vote:m1}}.

The Acting Treasurer role matters to residents because the Treasurer is the Region's senior financial officer, so the appointment keeps that function filled while the Region's financial business continues.

Council also discussed the Region's practice of not posting by-laws online with the meeting agenda. The Regional Clerk explained that the procedure by-law sets this process and that by-laws are always available to Council and the public on request. Council asked that, for future special meetings held only to consider a by-law, the by-law be attached to the agenda. The meeting had no presentations, reports or correspondence.

decisions.detail: Council approved the by-law for enactment, including the by-law appointing an Acting Treasurer and repealing By-Law Number 24-033 {{vote:m1}}.
